recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-24878 unless a future work-group decision revisits List ordering semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-24878 was Published with resolution Persuasive for R5. It asked to add orderMeaning to List.entry because List.orderedBy gives the collection an order meaning, with wording that order has no meaning unless asserted by List.orderedBy and then SHALL be interpreted as specified by List.orderedBy.
initial_application: The request was applied by commit 9a4ebc567875e0fb6d6a4c0411d19a26eb483a6a and merged as ea027fdbee6dfa8a498dffc4a701d7678e8e3d55, adding the orderMeaning line to source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml. The current active source still contains that text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists List as an active resource. The original Zulip thread led directly to tracker 24878, and FHIR-I minutes on 2020-03-23 record a 7-0-0 persuasive vote for setting orderMeaning indicating no order unless specified by orderedBy. Earlier Published List ordering issues FHIR-3661 and FHIR-7502 support the List.orderedBy model and preserved item order semantics rather than reversing this issue.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative StructureDefinition source already matches the approved resolution and broader List ordering context.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue that replaced the old List.ordered boolean with List.orderedBy, the element referenced by FHIR-24878. It is already represented on the combined branch by its own audit commit.
Earlier Published issue clarifying that the List itself preserves item order while implementations or IGs define preservation requirements for particular functions.
